author: The Infographics Show
description:
The Nazi party was led by a collection of bureaucrats, architects, and fanatics who orchestrated the greatest atrocities of the 20th century. While some sought to escape justice by fleeing to South America, others faced the gallows or took their own lives as the regime collapsed.

Today's insane new video is a definitive countdown of the final moments of the Nazi top brass, from the "Angel of Death" to the Fuhrer himself.
